# PLUSZONE Education

> A value-centered character education method developed by two Korean teachers — a school health teacher with 34 years and an elementary school teacher with 22 years in the classroom. It is built on "the mathematics of character education": differentiate (dy/dx) each momentary choice and integrate (∫) Plus Zone values. The site is in English and Korean; the operator is PLUSZONE EDUSOLUTION (Republic of Korea).

Key ideas:

- **Coordinate plane of consciousness**: the x-axis is action driven by good thoughts, the y-axis is consciousness grown through those actions. Every choice moves consciousness into the Plus (+) Zone (growth), the Zero (0) Zone (no change, +1−1=0) or the Minus (−) Zone (decline).
- Plus, Zero and Minus are not labels for a child or for feelings; they are standards for reflecting on thoughts and choices in the moment.
- **Three solutions**: Higher Growth (reflect on each choice and turn Minus into Plus), Higher Rapport (a sustainable relationship of mutual growth that turns feedback and relationship crises into learning), and the 3S (3-Step) Questioning Method.
- **3S Questioning Method**: S1 Self-Reflection — "Why did I think and act that way?"; S2 Setting Plus (+) Standards — "Are my thoughts and actions Plus or Minus?"; S3 Standards into Action — "So, what should I do now, and how?"

## English pages

- [Home](https://edupluszone.com/): overview, the coordinate plane, three solutions, student videos, teacher voices
- [The Method](https://edupluszone.com/approach.html): coordinate plane of consciousness, Higher Growth, Higher Rapport, 3S Questioning Method
- [Classroom Cases](https://edupluszone.com/stories.html): student guidance videos, how students changed, classroom dialogues, teacher voices (all student names are pseudonyms)
- [The Book](https://edupluszone.com/book.html): A Teacher's Guide to the Art of Character Education — Higher Rapport (Insaeng Books, 314 pages)
- [Meet the Authors](https://edupluszone.com/about.html): Kim Kyeong-Hyi and Kim Hye-Jin
- [Contact](https://edupluszone.com/contact.html): teacher training, consulting, partnerships, bulk book orders — info@edupluszone.com
- [Brochure (PDF, English)](https://edupluszone.com/PLUSZONE-Edusolution-Brochure.pdf)

## Optional

- [3S Practice Room](https://pluszone-edusolution.app/?lang=en): free web app to practise the three questions with classroom situation cards and AI feedback, including practice conversations with parents (about 3 minutes, no sign-up; English and Korean)
